name: Labhraidh Luathlam ar Cleb

attributes.attribute: ruler of Mag Mell, the plain of honey
fairy queen and sister of Labhraidh's wife
tempted by Fand to break faith with Emer

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Labhraidh Luathlam ar Cleb was an Irish hero or god. He ruled Mag Mell, the plain of honey, where the trees stayed heavy with magical fruit and the mead would not run out. He arranged for the hero Cuchulainn to spend time with Fand, the fairy queen and sister of his wife. In return, Cuchulainn had to defeat three warriors who troubled Labhraidh. The bargain created a love triangle, for Fand was the one companion who tempted Cuchulainn to break faith with his wife Emer. The tale appears in an old text called Cuchulainn's Sickness. It also shaped the play The Only Jealousy of Emer by William Butler Yeats.

okr.objective: Present Labhraidh Luathlam ar Cleb as an Irish hero or god who ruled the otherworld plain of honey.
key_results: Include the meeting of Cuchulainn and Fand arranged by Labhraidh.
State the return owed: defeating three warriors who troubled Labhraidh.
Note the love triangle with Emer and the connection to Yeats.
